The '''Sern sector''' contained the planets [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]] and [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]]. This sector was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. The Sern sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]] and in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by [[Gebnerret Vibrion]].
